visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a gray sleeveless tank top and large green insulated oven mitts holds up a large black baking tray. The tray is filled with rows of round, golden-brown baked buns topped with white sesame seeds. The background is a bright indoor kitchen space with metal appliances and glass windows. (2) Close-up of a worker's hands on a polished metal countertop, using a wooden rolling pin to flatten a long, rectangular piece of pale dough. Various kitchen containers, including a pink basket and white bins, are blurred in the background. (3) Hands scatter a large quantity of vibrant green chopped scallions onto the flattened dough strip. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the fresh texture of the onions. The worker's hands move systematically across the dough's surface. (4) A close-up shot shows hands skillfully folding and stuffing dough balls with a mixture of dark green pickled vegetables and small red chili fragments. The ingredients are held in a white plastic colander. The person wears a silver bracelet on their left wrist. (5) The camera captures a display case inside the shop, showing rows of various baked pastries and buns on metal racks. Some are long and flat, while others are small and round. The glass reflects the outdoor street lighting. (6) A hand holds a single round bun in a white paper bag against a blurred shop background. The bun is heavily coated in white sesame seeds. It is then pulled apart to reveal a dense filling of bright green onions and seasoned meat. (7) Another round bun, distinguished by a mix of black and white sesame seeds on top, is held up. When torn open, it displays a rich, dark green filling of chopped pickled mustard greens. The dough looks fluffy and steaming. (8) A view of the shop's exterior reveals a sign for "黃橋燒餅" and a menu board with prices. Several customers wearing motorcycle helmets stand on the sidewalk waiting. Scooters are parked in front of the open-fronted store.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female narrator begins speaking in a high-pitched, enthusiastic Mandarin tone over a bright, major-key electronic pop background track. The music has a steady, synthesized beat at 110 BPM. She introduces the bakery, maintaining a friendly and professional broadcast quality. (2) As the visual transitions through the dough preparation, the narrator's voice remains energetic with a high speech rate. The BGM remains consistent in the background, providing a cheerful, upbeat atmosphere. No incidental kitchen noises are audible, indicating a clean studio voiceover overlay. (3) The vocal intonation becomes more descriptive and varied as she discusses the specific fillings of the buns. The pitch variability peaks when describing the "hidden version" pickled vegetable bun. The spectral brightness of the BGM complements the clear vocal clarity. (4) The audio concludes with a warm closing remark and a call to action. The BGM maintains its tempo until the very end, fading out slightly as the video stops. The signal-to-noise ratio is excellent, with the voice clearly dominating the mix.
